interpretation.prose: All three rows in each arm were coherent three-sentence explanations, but the frozen lexical predicate required a preserv* substring. The outputs used equivalent matching/identity language. These remain frozen-checker failures, not post-hoc passes.

rows.content: A smaller draft model rapidly generates candidate tokens, which are then batch-verified in parallel by the larger target model. The target model accepts or rejects these candidates based on its own probability distribution, ensuring the final output matches what the target model would have produced independently. This parallel verification process significantly increases throughput by reducing the number of sequential decoding steps required.
